clue.text: Notable characteristic of Camille's opulent lifestyle?

definitions.text: Notable characteristic of Camille's opulent lifestyle?

parts.words: Notable characteristic of Camille's opulent lifestyle?
parts.note: surface reading: a showy, lavish way of living such as a Parisian courtesan's; setter's reading: Camille, the heroine of Dumas's La Dame aux Camélias, is famous for dying of tuberculosis, a disease she shows openly

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase for showy spending on luxuries also describes Camille, whose tuberculosis (old name: consumption) was plain for all to see.
explanation.definitionFit: Economist Thorstein Veblen's term for lavish spending meant to display wealth, here punning on the old name for tuberculosis.

clue.text: Conspirators hack a Linux startup

parts.note: a hack is a taxi, an old American slang sense
taken as written

indicators.note: the start of the operating system's name is its first letter, so only that is used

parts.note: the first letter of Linux

explanation.surface: Plotters break into a computer as Linux boots up.
explanation.walkthrough: Hack and startup make it sound like computing; a hack is a taxi.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabal is a secret group of plotters, a collective noun for conspirators.

clue.text: Lightweight computer with transcendental number (28) in a corner

indicators.note: the number and disease are put in, so the corner wraps round them

parts.note: a nook is a corner
e, the base of natural logarithms, is a transcendental number
the answer at 28 is the old name for tuberculosis, abbreviated TB

explanation.surface: A light laptop with pi or e stored in a corner.
explanation.walkthrough: E and TB go together inside NOOK; the cross-reference points at 28, whose disease is abbreviated TB.
explanation.definitionFit: A netbook is a small, light, cheap laptop built mainly for web use.

clue.text: Elder playing part on broken chair

indicators.note: in a down answer, one piece placed on another sits above it, so it comes first
playing suggests the letters of the next word are being toyed with and moved around
a broken chair is in pieces, so its letters are reassembled in a new order

explanation.surface: An older actor takes a role while perched on a damaged chair.
explanation.walkthrough: Two separate anagrams: PART gives PATR and CHAIR gives IARCH, and 'on' stacks the first over the second in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A patriarch is the senior male head of a family or community, an elder in the respected sense.

clue.text: For instance, 8 baby elephants in front

parts.note: a cub is a young animal

indicators.note: the front of a word is its opening letter, so just that one is taken

parts.note: the first letter of elephants

explanation.surface: Eight young elephants lead the herd.
explanation.walkthrough: The 8 here is not a cross-reference to 8-down but the number: 8 is 2 × 2 × 2.
explanation.definitionFit: Eight is two raised to the third power, so it is an example of a perfect cube number.

clue.text: Collectibles brought up, Derek flies an arrow

indicators.note: in a down entry, bringing up means reading from the bottom upwards

parts.note: Bo Derek, actress in the film 10
to jet is to fly
a dart is a small arrow

explanation.surface: Raising collectibles, someone called Derek shoots an arrow.
explanation.walkthrough: Derek is the surname clue for the actress Bo Derek; only her first name is reversed.
explanation.definitionFit: Objets d'art are small decorative objects valued and gathered by collectors.

clue.text: Anarchist's search: CEO, oddly

indicators.note: oddly points to the odd-numbered positions, so the first, third, fifth and so on are kept

parts.note: the first, third, fifth, seventh and ninth letters

explanation.surface: An anarchist goes looking for a company boss, in a strange way.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for is, joining definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Nicola Sacco was an Italian-American anarchist executed with Bartolomeo Vanzetti in 1927.

clue.text: Film director anticipating conclusion of Rumble Fish

indicators.note: to anticipate is to come ahead of something, so one piece is placed before the other

parts.note: to angle is to fish with rod and line

indicators.note: the conclusion of a word is its final letter, so only that one is kept

parts.note: the final letter of rumble

explanation.surface: A movie director looking forward to the ending of Coppola's film Rumble Fish.
explanation.walkthrough: Rumble Fish reads as one film title, but it splits: Fish is the verb that goes first, and Rumble only supplies its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Ang Lee is the Taiwanese-born director of Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon and Brokeback Mountain.

clue.text: General greeting for rotten weather forecast?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a salutation offered to everyone, or to a commander
second meaning, read literally: a prediction of nothing but icy pellets falling from the sky

explanation.walkthrough: General can be the army rank or mean universal; the question mark flags the literal weather reading.
explanation.definitionFit: The archaic salute of acclamation, as in Macbeth, also reads literally as a grim outlook of hailstones everywhere.

clue.text: To manage after bacchanalian orgy on Saturday, this will keep you steady

indicators.note: the Saturday letter sits next to, on, the rearranged letters
the managing word comes after everything before it
a bacchanalian orgy is wild and disorderly, so its letters are thrown into disorder

parts.note: the word whose letters are rearranged
S is the common abbreviation for Saturday
to cope is to manage or get by

explanation.surface: Advice for getting by after a weekend of wild partying: here is something to keep you steady.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a hangover cure, but the definition is a description, fair because a gyroscope's spin resists tipping; 'on' and 'after' fix the order of the three pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A gyroscope is a spinning wheel whose momentum resists changes in orientation, so it is used to stabilise ships and instruments.

clue.text: A Thursday/Tuesday walk outside, naked? I could get into that

definitions.text: naked? I could get into that

indicators.note: the walk is placed on the outside, wrapping round the other pieces

parts.note: in baseball a walk is a base on balls, scored BB
taken as written
standard abbreviation for Thursday
standard abbreviation for Tuesday

explanation.surface: Someone muses about taking a nude stroll on a Thursday or Tuesday, and fancies joining in.
explanation.walkthrough: BATHTUB is A, TH and TU inside BB. A walk in baseball is a base on balls, abbreviated BB.
explanation.definitionFit: A tub is something you climb into once undressed, which is what the cryptic hint describes.

clue.text: Merry jests, originally related to peepers

indicators.note: originally points to the start of the word, so its opening letter alone is taken

parts.note: the opening letter of jests
peepers are eyes, and ocular means relating to the eye

explanation.surface: Jokes that once had something to do with eyes.
explanation.definitionFit: Jocular means joking and good-humoured, close in sense to merry.

clue.text: During a football game, pass bathroom with relatives

parts.note: loo is British slang for toilet
kin are family members

explanation.surface: In the middle of a game, a player slips off to the toilet with family.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the whole first half: in American football a look-in is a quick short pass.
explanation.definitionFit: A look-in is a short, quick throw to a receiver cutting inside, a term from American football.

clue.text: Pieces of furniture arranged onto mats

indicators.note: arranging things puts them into a fresh order, so these letters are set out anew

parts.note: the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: Furniture being set down on top of rugs.
explanation.definitionFit: An ottoman is a low upholstered seat or footstool, a kind of furniture.

clue.text: Kitchen item with orange-yellow spice turning south to west around floral wreath

indicators.note: the spice word, once changed, goes around the wreath word
turning south to west means the compass letter for south changes into the one for west
to marks the direction of the change, the letter for south becoming the letter for west

parts.note: saffron is an orange-yellow spice made from crocus stigmas
S is the compass abbreviation for south
W is the compass abbreviation for west
a lei is a Hawaiian garland of flowers

explanation.surface: A kitchen gadget is described alongside saffron, compass directions and a garland of flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning south to west' reads like a compass bearing, but it is a letter swap made before the container step; the changed spice then goes 'around' the Hawaiian garland.
explanation.definitionFit: A waffle iron is a hinged, patterned griddle pan used to cook waffles, a common piece of kitchen equipment.

clue.text: A pair, perhaps: Kronos to begin with, then Hera swimming in a small lake

indicators.note: the letters built from Kronos and Hera go in the lake word

parts.note: a pond is a small body of still water

indicators.note: only the first letter of Kronos is used

parts.note: the Titan whose initial letter is taken

indicators.note: swimming suggests movement, so the letters of the goddess's name are rearranged

parts.note: the goddess whose name is rearranged

explanation.surface: Two Greek gods appear together, one of them swimming in a pond.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A pair' looks like the two gods but is the definition, with 'perhaps' marking it as one example among several card combinations.
explanation.definitionFit: In poker, a pair is one of the ranked combinations of cards, so it is an example of a poker hand.

clue.text: Chief publishes "A Yank Is Heard"

indicators.note: is heard means it is spoken and caught by the ear, so the sound matters, not the spelling

parts.note: to publish is to print, and a yank is a pull

explanation.surface: A boss brings out a book or headline titled A Yank Is Heard.
explanation.walkthrough: Yank looks like an American; here it is a sharp tug.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective principal means first in importance, a synonym for chief.

clue.text: Nobel Prize–winning playwright returning product of olive leaf

parts.note: Dario Fo, Italian dramatist, won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1997

parts.note: olives are pressed for oil

explanation.surface: A Nobel laureate dramatist is brought back to something made from olive leaves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Olive leaf' looks like one thing; the definition is the single word leaf.
explanation.definitionFit: A folio is a single sheet or leaf of a book or manuscript.

clue.text: Grip net if tangled — it wrinkles when wet

indicators.note: something tangled is twisted out of order, so these letters are mixed up

parts.note: the letters to rearrange, taking in the if as well

explanation.surface: Grab a snarled fishing net, which puckers once soaked.
explanation.walkthrough: The if belongs to the fodder as well as the surface, so all nine letters of grip net if are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Skin on the ends of the fingers puckers after a long soak in a bath, a familiar observation.

clue.text: European flower near capital of Hungary

parts.note: an iris is a flower

indicators.note: a capital is a word's head letter, so only the first is taken

parts.note: the first letter of Hungary

explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital of Hungary' invites Budapest, but here it is just the initial letter. Flower is a real bloom, not the crossword river.
explanation.definitionFit: Irish describes someone from Ireland, a country in Europe, so an Irish person is a European.

clue.text: Concern about V., the first experimental novel

parts.note: the first is number one, written as I

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the letters of the book go round the V
something experimental tries out new forms, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Worry over Thomas Pynchon's V., the original avant-garde novel.
explanation.walkthrough: V. really is Pynchon's first novel, which makes 'experimental novel' read as praise rather than an instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: To concern something is to affect or relate to it, which is what involve means as a verb.

clue.text: Cheer following remote and lively dance

taken as written
olé is a Spanish cry of approval

parts.note: the letters to rearrange
